subject: EU Azure listing - permitted iconography & 24x7 support-window evidence mapping
messages:
From: Sophie Graham <sophie.graham@azure-marketplace.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Gabe Ortiz <gabe.ortiz@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure listing: iconography & support-window evidence for EU region

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for working with us on the CloudBridge listing in the Azure Marketplace. Before we push the co-sell badge into the EU tenant, legal asked us to clarify two items so the listing copy and assets are compliant:

1) Support SLA evidence: What specific artifacts do you provide that prove 24x7 coverage for EU customers? The Marketplace team typically needs an SLA matrix (hours by region/timezone), on-call roster cadence, and the escalation SLA with Azure ops. Can you point to a file or audit evidence?

2) Iconography and logos: Azure has strict rules about co-branding. We need to confirm which Redwood icons are permitted (co-sell badge, product icon, and any localized variants). Also: is there any trademark footnote copy we must include for the EU listing (e.g., trademark owner line in the footer)?

If you can send a single packet (SLA matrix + permitted icons + suggested footer copy), we can fast-track the marketplace QA. Ideally by tomorrow EOD EU time as we have a listing window next week.

Attached: none (initial ask).

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call if simpler.

Best,
Sophie
Partner Programs | Microsoft Azure Marketplace

---
Sophie Graham
Microsoft Corporation

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Graham <sophie.graham@azure-marketplace.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Gabe Ortiz <gabe.ortiz@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure listing: iconography & support-window evidence for EU region

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear ask.

Short answer: we can provide the SLA matrix and the approved EU icon set; we also have suggested footer/trademark copy we typically use for EU marketplace listings. I will pull together a single packet and share first thing tomorrow morning (PST).

Quick notes / internal asks (cc'd Ben and Marissa):
- Ben: can you attach the latest SLA matrix (hours by region + on-call escalation) and confirm the escalation windows we commit to for Azure co-sell listings? We should include RTO/RPO row if available.
- Marissa: please include the EU-localized logo variants and the brand guidance PDF with the permitted icon sizes/color palettes. Also confirm whether any localization footnote is required for German/French storefronts.

Sophie — we'll aim to get the packet to you by 08:00 UTC tomorrow (Thu). If that timing doesn't work, let me know a preferred deadline.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Attachment: none (planning message)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sophie Graham <sophie.graham@azure-marketplace.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure listing: iconography & support-window evidence for EU region

Kimberly / Sophie — attaching the packet for review.

Attachments:
- redwood-sla-matrix-v1.xlsx (Excel, 42 KB) — includes region/timezone rows, primary on-call roster cadence, escalation SLAs to Azure (P1: 15 min ack, 2 hr mitigation; P2: 1 hr ack, 6 hr mitigation), and RTO/RPO notes.
- brand-iconography-guidelines-v2.pdf (PDF, 82 KB) — permitted AWS/Azure/GCP co-branding icons, allowed color overlays, and safe-area rules.
- brand-assets-eu-logos.zip (ZIP, 6 MB) — EU-localized logo files (SVG/PNG) and language variants.

Proposed listing copy snippet (for marketing team / marketplace UI):
"Support: 24x7* technical support (see support window mapping below)."

Proposed footnote: 
"*24x7 denotes continuous technical support across EMEA timezones; response SLAs vary by severity. See detailed matrix in attached SLA document. Redwood Inference is a trademark of Redwood Labs, Inc."

Question for Azure/legal: does the marketplace require the full trademark owner line inside the listing footer, or is a link to the legal page sufficient? Sophie, if Azure has a preference, we can adapt the wording.

Marissa, two quick asks before I send to marketing: please confirm the approved hero icon (color vs. monochrome) for EU stores and whether we should include the co-sell badge in both hero and details sections.

Thanks — Ben
Senior Marketplace Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: redwood-sla-matrix-v1.xlsx, brand-iconography-guidelines-v2.pdf, brand-assets-eu-logos.zip

From: Gabe Ortiz <gabe.ortiz@cloudbridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure listing: iconography & support-window evidence for EU region

Team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the packet. I reviewed the attachments and they look sensible. A couple of follow-ups from CloudBridge before we mark QA ready:

1) Trademark footnote: legal prefers the full owner line in the listing footer for the EU marketplace (not just a link). Can Redwood confirm final wording and an example placement?

2) Co-sell badge placement: we prefer the badge in the hero and the details view, but Azure sometimes forces single-placement. Sophie, can you confirm marketplace UI constraints?

3) DocuSign / co-sell addendum: we need the signed co-sell addendum before we activate the badge. Please send the DocuSign link or confirm timeline for signature.

If helpful, I'm available for a 15-min call tomorrow 09:00-12:00 UTC to finalize the footnote and badge placement. Otherwise we can iterate over email.

Best,
Gabe Ortiz
Head of Partnerships | CloudBridge Solutions
Attachment: none
